coffee.notes: Ramble and Roast is consistently one of my favourite coffees. Always an interesting, acidy, tasty coffee - a must have if you're anywhere near Oxenholme.

aroma.notes: Sweet berry, blueberry, raspberry, turning towards orange

sweetness.notes: Really not very sweet at all. There's a bit of velvet chocolate if I hunt for it. Maybe caramel.

finish.notes: Disappointingly fleeting. I wish I could enjoy it for longer. But it leaves a refreshing apple.

space.notes: I mean, it's literally a car boot in a train station. At least it's convenient

notes: Ramble and Roast is all about the coffee. By the nature of their car-bar it's no frills, so they really have to compete on their coffee - and compete they do. I've had worse coffees at specialty traditional cafes. If you are ever in or near Oxenholme, you gotta come here.
